## Skitterdark (CR 3)

**XP** 800  
CE Tiny outsider (chaotic, demon, evil, extraplanar)  
**Init** +3; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +8  

**Defense**

 **AC** 19, touch 16, flat-footed 15 (+3 Dex, +1 dodge, +3 natural, +2 size)  
**hp** 52 (4d10+12)  
**Fort** +7, **Ref** +4, **Will** +5  
**DR** 5/cold iron; **Immune** electricity, poison; **Resist** acid 10, cold 10, fire 10; **SR** 14  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 20 ft., fly 40 ft. (good)  
**Melee** 2 claws +9 (1d3+3), bite +9 (1d4+3)  
**Space** 2-1/2 ft.; **Reach** 0 ft.  
**Special Attacks** profane claws  
**Spell-Like Abilities** (CL 5th)  

 At will—detect good, detect magic  
1/day—hold person (DC 13), scare (DC 13)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 8, **Dex** 17, **Con** 16, **Int** 11, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 12  
**Base Atk** +4; **CMB** +9; **CMD** 15  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), [Weapon Finesse](../../rules/feats/weapon-finesse.md)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Weapon Finesse adds Dex instead of Str to finesse damage and CMB.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +10, Escape Artist +10, Fly +18, Perception +8, Stealth +18, Survival +8  
**Languages** Abyssal, Common  
**SQ** clustering  

**Special Abilities**

 **Clustering (Ex)** Because of their small size and swarming tactics, up to 4 skitterdarks can fit in the same 5-foot space and function normally.  

 **Profane Claws (Su)** Any good-aligned creature hit by a skitterdark’s claw attack takes normal damage plus 1d6 points of profane damage.  

**Ecology**

**Environment** any (Abyss)  
**Organization** gang (3–6), roving band (7–10), or swarm (11–16)  
**Treasure** half standard
